title: 3Sum
prompt: Given an integer array nums, return all the triplets [nums[i], nums[j], nums[k]] such that i != j, i != k, and j != k, and nums[i] + nums[j] + nums[k] == 0. The solution set must not contain duplicate triplets.
hints: Sort the array first. For each element, use two pointers to find pairs that sum to -nums[i].
Fix one number (i), then use two pointers (left, right) on the rest to find two numbers that sum to target.
Skip duplicates: after using nums[i], skip all same values. Same for left/right when moving.
O(n^2) time. Sort is O(n log n).
